label: Medical & Healthcare
description: Production-aware visual vocabulary for healthcare environments, care teams, patient movement, clinical equipment and safe blocking.

zones.label: Consultation Room
zones.prompt: recognizable consultation room with examination area, clinician workstation and clear patient-clinician eyelines

zones.label: Hospital Room
zones.prompt: hospital patient room with care bed, bedside equipment, visitor position and unobstructed staff access

zones.label: Operating Room
zones.prompt: operating theatre with central procedure table, surgical light, sterile working field and organized equipment perimeter

zones.label: Emergency Bay
zones.prompt: emergency treatment bay with stretcher, monitoring equipment, privacy curtain and a clear clinical approach path

zones.label: Ambulance Interior
zones.prompt: compact ambulance treatment compartment with secured stretcher, seated medic position and wall-mounted emergency equipment

zones.label: Rehabilitation Gym
zones.prompt: rehabilitation gym with open exercise floor, parallel bars and supervised patient movement space

zones.label: Dental Operatory
zones.prompt: dental treatment room with patient chair, overhead lamp, instrument side and assistant working position

zones.label: Waiting Area
zones.prompt: healthcare waiting area with reception sightline, accessible circulation and separated seating groups

roles.label: Patient
roles.prompt: patient whose condition and mobility are readable without sensationalizing distress
roles.wardrobe: context-appropriate patient clothing or gown with stable visual continuity

roles.label: Physician
roles.prompt: physician positioned for clear communication, examination or team leadership
roles.wardrobe: clinical workwear or professional clothing with consistent identifier and silhouette

roles.label: Nurse
roles.prompt: nurse performing patient care with legible hand placement and access to equipment
roles.wardrobe: clinical scrubs with consistent color value, pockets and footwear silhouette

roles.label: Paramedic
roles.prompt: paramedic using stable body mechanics around a patient or stretcher
roles.wardrobe: recognizable emergency-service uniform with high-visibility panels and utility pockets

roles.label: Surgeon
roles.prompt: surgeon placed relative to sterile field and procedure team
roles.wardrobe: surgical scrubs, cap, mask and gloves with continuity across shots

roles.label: Clinical Assistant
roles.prompt: clinical assistant supporting the primary care action without obscuring the patient
roles.wardrobe: role-appropriate clinical workwear with a distinct silhouette

roles.label: Visitor
roles.prompt: visitor placed with a clear emotional relationship to the patient and care team
roles.wardrobe: civilian wardrobe maintained consistently across the sequence

propTypes.label: Medical Cart

propTypes.label: Dental Chair
propTypes.prompt: adjustable dental chair with headrest, base and adjacent delivery unit

actions.label: Consultation
actions.prompt: clear conversational triangle, attentive eyelines and readable exchange of information

actions.label: Examination
actions.prompt: clinician examination with anatomically plausible access and visible patient response

actions.label: Patient Transfer
actions.prompt: coordinated patient transfer with stable support points, clear source and destination surfaces

actions.label: Emergency Response
actions.prompt: urgent but organized team response with readable task allocation and unobstructed patient access

actions.label: Clinical Procedure
actions.prompt: controlled clinical procedure with a clear working field and supporting roles

actions.label: Rehabilitation
actions.prompt: guided rehabilitation movement with visible balance, support and progress direction

actions.label: Care Handover
actions.prompt: care-team handover with shared focus on patient information and role continuity

states.label: Calm
states.prompt: calm, controlled care environment with open posture and measured pacing

states.label: Concerned
states.prompt: concern communicated through restrained expression, body angle and eyeline

states.label: Urgent
states.prompt: time-critical energy expressed through purposeful movement without visual chaos

states.label: Recovering
states.prompt: patient recovery conveyed through supported posture, reduced exertion and attentive supervision

states.label: Reassured
states.prompt: reassurance conveyed through proximity, softened posture and direct communication

safetyContexts.label: Fictional, Non-instructional
safetyContexts.prompt: depict a fictional production scene, not medical instruction or a procedural guide

safetyContexts.label: Dignified Care
safetyContexts.prompt: preserve patient dignity, avoid graphic injury and avoid exploitative framing

safetyContexts.label: Plausible Access
safetyContexts.prompt: keep staff access, exits, equipment clearance and patient support spatially plausible

safetyContexts.label: No Readable Health Data
safetyContexts.prompt: do not render readable names, diagnoses, records or other personal health information

safetyContexts.label: Sterile Zoning
safetyContexts.prompt: make sterile and non-sterile working zones visually distinct without teaching a procedure

continuityLocks.label: Patient Side
continuityLocks.prompt: lock patient screen direction, bed orientation and clinician side across connected shots

continuityLocks.label: Equipment Layout
continuityLocks.prompt: lock the relative placement and cable direction of major clinical equipment

continuityLocks.label: Wardrobe Identifiers
continuityLocks.prompt: lock role-specific wardrobe, badges and protective-equipment state across the scene

continuityLocks.label: Condition State
continuityLocks.prompt: lock visible patient condition, mobility support and attached equipment unless the script changes them

continuityLocks.label: Clean/Used State
continuityLocks.prompt: lock the clean, opened or used state of visible supplies across chronological shots
